⚠️ The next move is yours.
10 days to file arbitration
or accept liability

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

You have a rebuttal:
file the pre-arbitration response

No further stage.
Amex's decision is final

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Is the amount worth
a USD 400–800 downside
on a loss?

specific objection?
